articles.summary: Mo is Momentic's AI QA engineer: point it at your app, tell it what to test, and get back a bug report with repro steps and video. No scripts to write.
articles.title: Mo: A Future Without Tests

articles.summary: Teams repriced testing from wages to tokens, and most of those tokens return nothing. Here is why verification spend buys less than it should, the four criteria that separate well-spent tokens from waste, and the teams already testing token efficiently.
articles.title: Testing Must Be Token Efficient
